name: testmu-ai
description: Agentic AI quality engineering. Run, debug and triage tests on the TestMu AI cloud, plus the Kane CLI skill for browser automation and test authoring and the Rook CLI skill for testing AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Run, debug and triage tests on the TestMu AI cloud, plus Kane CLI and Rook CLI skills
interface.longDescription: TestMu AI (Formerly LambdaTest) is an Agentic AI Quality Engineering platform that assures AI deployments across the enterprise and the real world. It runs agentic testing for web and mobile apps on 3,000+ browsers and 50,000+ real devices, and for chat, voice, IVR, video, and image agents. This plugin connects Kimi to the hosted TestMu AI MCP server (OAuth sign-in in the browser, no API keys in config) to run, debug and triage tests across web automation, HyperExecute, SmartUI visual testing, accessibility scans and Test Manager. It also adds the Kane CLI skill for browser and mobile test automation from natural-language objectives, and the Rook CLI skill for testing how AI agents behave before they ship.

testmu-ai.description: Hosted MCP server for test runs, failure triage, SmartUI, accessibility and Test Manager. Sign in with your TestMu AI account.

kanecli-skill.description: Browser and mobile test automation and test authoring from natural-language objectives

rook-skill.description: Test, evaluate and red-team AI agents before they ship
